{{Top|leg}}
'''Walker Operations and Tactics''' was an [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] training center on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jardeen IV]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Arndall Lott]] commanded Walker Operations and Tactics until the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].
